ExcelJS 4.4.0 browser bundle, loaded on demand for GameTracker Excel reports.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exceljs@4.4.0/dist/exceljs.min.js
Project: https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs/tree/v4.4.0
License: MIT (see exceljs-LICENSE.txt).

Keeping the pinned bundle here lets exports use the site's own assets without
requiring a third-party CDN request at download time.
